summary: Murder committed inside police station by appellant (police guard); prosecution established premeditated murder via eye witnesses including injured PW-2; self-defense and sudden provocation claims rejected; credible testimonies of PW-2, PW-1, PW-14, PW-17 corroborated by medical evidence; forensic confirmation of ballistic trajectory; defense witnesses PW-6 and PW-25 partially supported prosecution on illicit relationship but testified deceased intended to kill appellant; trial and high court convictions for Sections 302/307 IPC upheld.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentences under Sections 302 (life imprisonment) and 307 IPC (7 years rigorous imprisonment) upheld.
